mcqs.question: What was the value of India’s defence exports in 2025–26?
mcqs.explanation: India’s defence exports reached ₹38,424 crore in 2025–26, registering a 62.66% increase. ₹35,000 crore was the DPEPP 2020 target, while ₹21,071 crore and ₹17,353 crore were the respective contributions of DPSUs and private companies.
